scope: Additive WB-ACTOR-COMPOSE-001 candidate retrieval questions; frozen baseline untouched.

questions.query: Can I place physical NPCs and a human flyer together in ordinary Shared Workbench?
facts: The candidate catalogue exposes59 existing physical identities: eight flyers,46 physical rigs,four4LY profiles and a passive barrel.
Each admitted actor independently selects human,scripted,policy or passive authority; passive barrel accepts only passive.
One existing native worker and Rapier session own gameplay; there is no imported Thunderbowl arena or second running World.

questions.query: Does inspecting a scripted NPC or painting terrain take over its control?
facts: Inspection and human pilot are independent; only an explicit pilot or controller action changes producer.
Live takeover cancels old commands and issued observations while preserving body graph,pose,momentum,resources and compatible equipment.
NPC schedules continue while inspecting or painting; pause stops gameplay and focus loss cancels affected human input.

questions.query: How can an external controller safely drive a Workbench actor and what happens to late replies?
facts: The adapter issues copied physical observations and submits through the existing version2 physical_wire_action leased envelope.
Wrong actor,producer,run,epoch,sequence or stale/unissued observation refuses; replacement retires the old actor authority.
The deterministic policy fixture proves actual observation/action consumption; it is not a neural model or network service.

questions.query: How are actor capacity and equipment accounted for in mixed Workbench casts?
facts: Separate limits admit at most eight logical actors,eight prepared parts per actor and64 actual response bodies/native occupancy proxies.
Compound masks map to their real body owner; equipment chassis and released items keep reserved capacity.
Tool requests use the existing ACT005 physical authority,mask/hit validation and native material accounting.

questions.query: Does saving a mixed actor start restore live NPC physics or policy memory?
facts: Optional strict control-v1 fields extend existing Setup-v2 and its generated-start/material-baseline containers.
Save retains authored models,spawns,compatible options,controller configuration and starting equipment.
Load reconstructs authored starts; live momentum,resource consumption,policy memory and outstanding commands are not persisted.

questions.query: Which sampled or Thunderbowl research controllers run in Shared Workbench?
facts: The full sampled session and arena remain outside the physical Workbench owner.
A narrow copied-view policy adapter reuses the pure local steering helper for compatible ordinary ground/jump physical rigs.
Virtual tag,oracle privilege,sampled metal actuation,NCA training and operational model services are not claimed.
